in_sanskrit.name: Saiyad
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Name
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saiyad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name 'Saiyad' is believed to be derived from the Arabic word 'Sayyid', which means 'lord' or 'master'. In Hinduism, it is often used as a title for Muslim saints and scholars. It is also considered a divine name, invoking the blessings of the deity Sai Baba.
